The .SRCINFO file contains standard AUR package metadata for the feroxbuster-git package. It declares the source as a Git URL pointing to the official GitHub repository (https://github.com/epi052/feroxbuster), which is the expected and legitimate location for this AUR package. The version (2.13.1.r23.g1f595da) and description ("A fast, simple, recursive content discovery tool written in Rust") align with known project information. The only notable field is `sha256sums = SKIP`, which is a standard practice for VCS-based AUR packages. This indicates the package maintainer has intentionally skipped checksum verification for the source code, which is common and acceptable in AUR workflows. No obfuscated code, suspicious network calls, unauthorized file operations, or backdoor indicators are present. The file is purely declarative metadata and does not execute any code or modify system state.
